item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 20/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will strengthen slightly in the next couple of days. The weather will improve and it will be hot during the day over the coast of Guangdong. With the anticyclone aloft weakening midweek this week, it will be cloudier with one or two showers over the region. Under the influence of a trough of low pressure, there will be more showers with thunderstorms over southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China over the weekend.
